model_meta.description: Bearing architecture combining bearing balls and spherical rollers between inner and outer rings; relative element sizing yields ball-only support at small load and shared ball/roller support at higher load.

subsystems.description: Outer ring radially outside the inner ring; defines the outer raceway facing the inner raceway.
Inner ring radially inward of the outer ring; defines the inner raceway facing the outer raceway.
Multiple balls arranged around the raceways between the rings. Balls are larger than spherical rollers and exclusively take up the entire bearing load at small load.
Multiple spherical rollers disposed between the rings and rollable around the raceways; support bearing load together with balls at relatively high load.
Disposed between the rings and guides the rolling elements along the raceways.

requirements.statement: The bearing shall include inner and outer rings with facing raceways, bearing balls, spherical rollers, and a cage guiding the rolling elements along the raceways.
requirements.rationale: Claim 1 identifies these required elements and their arrangement.

requirements.statement: At small bearing load, the bearing balls shall exclusively take up the entire bearing load.
requirements.rationale: Claim 1; achieved by bearing balls larger than the widest diameter of the spherical rollers.

requirements.statement: Under relatively high bearing load, both the bearing balls and spherical rollers shall take up the bearing load.
requirements.rationale: Claim 4; relatively high load is qualitative and no threshold is specified.

actions.name: Support small bearing load with balls

steps.description: At small bearing load, the bearing balls, which are larger in diameter than the widest diameter of the spherical rollers, exclusively take up the entire bearing load.
